preservation.round2Embedded: variants/round-2-embedded/; original HTML, runtime, license, all five source files, plus mechanical before-spec.md and before-plan.md copies under definition/
preservation.inventoryConvention: Sorted lines of design-relative Windows path, space, actual SHA-256, joined with LF; round-1, pre-fix round-2, old screenshots and verification only. New round-3 evidence excluded.
preservation.repositoryData: Snapshot data unchanged except its purpose sentence. No classification backfill.
preservation.productScope: No writes outside this design directory; no product build, tasks, definitions, metadata, Git, Beads, installs, approvals, or test files.

limits: No screen reader, other browser engine, actual app endpoint, product build, or full functional runner.
Behavior will be checked independently by the Tester. Prior reports are evidence for prior bytes only.
The inherited search popup can cover a form when keyboard focus enters Search work; no navigation redesign was made.
Fluent announcements plus the polite capture status region retain the prior pattern; screen-reader duplicate speech was not checked.
200% is device-metrics emulation, not the app host zoom. Representative geometry and contrast observations are not full behavioral verification.
